scope: One independent source-versus-current-spec/SVG/preview mathematical, visual and cultural review of fig-70 only.

independence.amplitudeClarification: The first inventory misread the upper amplitude arrowhead as A. A later independent crop of the original disproved that impression; the original inventory is preserved and the pixel-only correction is disclosed in a separate supplement.

observations: Six top-to-bottom snapshots, each numbering 18 balls; 108 ball instances. Times 0, T/4, T/2, 3T/4, T, 5T/4. The same ball number retains its horizontal station.
At 0 all balls are on the equilibrium chain with no velocity vectors. Thereafter front stations are 4, 7, 10, 13 and 16: three intervals of advance per quarter period.
Unreached stationary tails are b5-18, c8-18, d11-18, e14-18 and f17-18. Zero-displacement front balls b4/c7/d10/e13/f16 have upward arrows, unlike those unreached balls.

Crest stations b1, c4, d7, e10, f1/f13; trough stations d1, e4, f7. No short velocity arrows appear at these extrema. Ball 1 follows equilibrium, crest, down-moving equilibrium, trough, up-moving equilibrium, crest.

There are 102 adjacent ball-pair connections and 39 nonzero-displacement projection guides. Their chain profiles bend only behind the advancing front. Each snapshot retains its shared equilibrium frame.

The 41 velocity arrows are b up2/3/4; c down1/2/3 and up5/6/7; d down2/3/4/5/6 and up8/9/10; e up1/2/3/11/12/13 and down5/6/7/8/9; f up2/3/4/5/6/14/15/16 and down8/9/10/11/12. Longer arrows are at zero crossings; shorter arrows nearer extrema.
Three source-given wavelength spans are e1-13, f2-14 and f3-15, each 12 station intervals. The two f spans are not interchangeable with replacing both by a crest-to-crest dimension.
The left-side b amplitude span is unlabeled, double-headed, and bounded by two horizontal terminal bars. The apparent A is its upper arrowhead, not a fourth mathematical label.
Cyrillic source panel labels may become Latin a-f; numeric ball labels, T and Greek lambda remain. The source is a culturally neutral ball-chain schematic, without people or national symbols.

currentInputs.contextVerdict: The spec binds complete current n38 and repaired n39 prose in zh/en plus all six n39 questions. Correct modern references are Figure 70e at T and Figure 70f at 5T/4. The n38 post-transient explanation is not used to impose a steady sinusoid on the early source snapshots. The n39 left/right motion describes transverse motion in the horizontal physical plane, not new propagation-direction arrows in this top-down schematic.

observationsByExactId.result: All 108 source-{a..f}-ball-{01..18} instances have visible SVG positions and correct number labels, with executable point relationships wholly within their mapped source group. All 102 source-{row}-spacing-displacement-{i}-{i+1} relationships and all interpolated adjacent-connection parts were checked. Object counts were not substituted for point relationships.

The unreached balls are flat and arrowless, not periodically continued. Front crossings move up. Reached equality is source-e-reached-equal-state-1-13 and source-f-reached-equal-state-1-13/2-14/3-15 only; no e2-14 or e3-15 equality is incorrectly asserted before those later balls are reached.

All 41 velocity directions, relative speed-length hierarchy and ball anchors match the source. Native materialized arrowheads are present. All 39 projection guides terminate at the corresponding ball and equilibrium station and carry connects assertions. Guides, velocity arrows and the separate amplitude dimension remain distinguishable.
All three exact span endpoints, six extension/endcap guides, six dimension arrowheads, three given lambda labels and 12-interval lengths match the source.

The candidate correctly preserves an unlabeled amplitude dimension. Direct magnification of the original corrected the reviewer's initial A impression. This is not a candidate failure and does not request a repair.

123 visible labels contain only 108 ball numbers, six Latin panel letters, six times and three source-given lambda labels. No Cyrillic/Chinese, national iconography, invented scenario, numeric adjacent-phase answer, or added answer-bearing formula appears. Vector colors use semantic CSS variables.

At actual media width 640, all 123 measured labels are 17 or 18 px, minimum 17 >=16, with no collisions/clipping. Mobile viewport390 has a 358px host and fixed640 media; the reused headed browser receipt records end282/max282 and all six row18 and time labels visible horizontally. Both mobile start/end images were independently opened.
